info.title: Lingopal API v2
info.description: Lingopal API for uploading media and documents, starting translation workflows, generating subtitles, translating text, and downloading generated artifacts.

get.description: Returns language capabilities filtered by dubbing, text, or all supported workflows.

200.description: Supported language list with capability flags.

500.description: The server failed to complete the request.

post.description: Translates one to 100 text inputs with a shared target language and optional context. Use `GET /v2/languages/text` to list supported languages.

translateTextMinimal.description: Translate text with only the required text inputs and target language.

translateTextWithOptions.description: Translate text with optional source language, context, and credit deduction control.

post.summary: Upload and register a small file
post.description: Uploads a small file directly to Lingopal and registers it as media or a document. For files larger than the direct upload limit, use `/v2/storage/uploads` multipart upload. Provide target languages and translation context later through the appropriate `/v2/jobs/{job_id}` workflow endpoint.

directVideoJobUpload.summary: Upload and register a small video file
directVideoJobUpload.description: Send the file bytes to Lingopal and receive a reusable job_id. Provide target languages later through the appropriate `/v2/jobs/{job_id}` workflow endpoint.

200.description: Registration result for the uploaded file.

413.description: File exceeds the direct upload limit.

post.description: Registers one or more uploaded or externally hosted file URLs as Lingopal media/document records. This endpoint records source metadata only; processing inputs such as target languages and translation context are supplied later through the appropriate `/v2/jobs/{job_id}` workflow endpoint. Per-item failures are returned in the `results` array with `status="error"`.

registerSingleFile.description: Register a source_url from `/v2/storage/uploads` as a reusable Lingopal file. Use the returned job_id with `/v2/jobs/{job_id}/translations` or `/v2/jobs/{job_id}/subtitles` to start processing.

registerMixedFileBatch.description: Register several already-uploaded sources in one request. Upload endpoints do not accept target languages or translation context; provide those to the appropriate `/v2/jobs/{job_id}` workflow endpoint.

get.description: Returns metadata for a reusable registered job.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

get.description: Returns current processing status for a reusable registered job.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

post.description: Starts translation for a reusable registered job. Video/audio files use the media translation workflow; document files use the document translation workflow.

post.summary: Generate subtitles for a registered job
post.description: Starts translated subtitle generation for a reusable registered media file.

get.description: Downloads a transcript for a registered job as JSON, CSV, TSV, or plain text.

200.description: Transcript file content or JSON transcript payload.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

post.summary: Export job transcript with selected columns
post.description: Exports a transcript for a registered job with optional include/exclude controls.

200.description: Transcript file content or JSON transcript payload.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

get.description: Downloads generated subtitles for a registered job as SRT or VTT.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

post.description: Returns one or more presigned S3 upload URLs for uploading a source file before registering it with `/v2/jobs/register`. Provide `file_size` to request a multipart upload.

singlePartStorageUpload.description: Request one presigned PUT URL for a client-managed source upload. Register the returned source_url later with `/v2/jobs/register`.

multipartStorageUpload.description: Request presigned part URLs for a large source upload. Complete the multipart upload with `/v2/storage/uploads/complete`, then register the returned source_url with `/v2/jobs/register`.

200.description: Presigned upload metadata and upload part URLs.

post.description: Completes an S3 multipart upload created by `/v2/storage/uploads`. Only uploads owned by the authenticated user can be completed.

completeMultipartStorageUpload.description: Finalize a multipart upload after every part has been uploaded to S3. Then register the returned source_url with `/v2/jobs/register`.

403.description: The authenticated user cannot access this resource.

request_type.title: Request Type
request_type.description: Language capability filter used for the response.

texts.title: Texts
texts.description: One to 100 source text inputs to translate. Aliases accepted: `text`, `content`.

target_language.title: Target Language
target_language.description: Single target locale code. Use `GET /v2/languages/text` to list supported text translation languages. Alias accepted: `language`.

source_language.title: Source Language
source_language.description: Optional source locale code. Use `GET /v2/languages/text` to list supported text translation languages. If omitted, Lingopal may auto-detect it.

context.title: Context
context.description: Optional context to improve translation quality.

deduct_credits.title: Deduct Credits
deduct_credits.description: Whether this request should deduct credits. Alias accepted: `deduct_credits_flag`.

file.title: File
file.description: Small source file to upload and register.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable summary of the batch registration result.

error_count.title: Error Count
error_count.description: Number of items that failed registration.

items.title: Items
items.description: One or more uploaded files to register.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.description: Current workflow statuses keyed by v2 workflow type.

error.title: Error
error.description: Processing error when the job failed.

target_languages.title: Target Languages
target_languages.description: Target locale codes. Alias accepted: `languages`. The job type determines whether media or document translation is started.

context.title: Context
context.description: Optional context used for document translation.

reset.title: Reset
reset.description: Whether to prune stale target languages before starting processing; active workflow progress is always refreshed for a new run.

remove_background_audio.title: Remove Background Audio
remove_background_audio.description: Whether to remove background audio for media translation.

number_of_speakers.title: Number Of Speakers
number_of_speakers.description: Optional speaker count hint for media translation. Use 0 to auto-detect.

burn_subtitles_on_source.title: Burn Subtitles On Source
burn_subtitles_on_source.description: Whether to burn generated subtitles onto source-language media.

prepend_ai_warning.title: Prepend Ai Warning
prepend_ai_warning.description: Whether to prepend an AI-generated-content warning.

enhance.title: Enhance
enhance.description: Whether to enable media enhancement when supported.

experimental_force_accent.title: Experimental Force Accent
experimental_force_accent.description: Whether to force accent handling for experimental workflows.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: Reusable registered job ID associated with this workflow.

target_languages.title: Target Languages
target_languages.description: Target locale codes requested for this workflow.

target_languages.title: Target Languages
target_languages.description: Target locale codes. Use `GET /v2/languages/text` to list supported subtitle translation languages. Alias accepted: `languages`.

reset.title: Reset
reset.description: Whether to prune existing subtitle target state before starting processing.

burn_subtitles.title: Burn Subtitles
burn_subtitles.description: Whether to burn generated subtitles into media output when supported.

include_source_language.title: Include Source Language
include_source_language.description: Whether to include source-language subtitles in generated outputs when supported.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Transcript locale to export. Use `source` for the original transcript.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Transcript response layout for JSON-style exports.

include_columns.title: Include Columns
include_columns.description: Additional transcript columns to include in the export.

exclude_columns.title: Exclude Columns
exclude_columns.description: Transcript columns to omit from the export.

file_ext.title: File Ext
file_ext.description: Source file extension, with or without a leading dot.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: Source file size in bytes. Provide this value to request multipart presigned upload URLs; omit it for a single PUT upload URL.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Final URL of the uploaded file after upload completion.

file_path.title: File Path
file_path.description: Storage path for the storage upload. Use this when completing multipart uploads.

upload_id.title: Upload Id
upload_id.description: S3 multipart upload ID. Present only when the storage upload uses multipart upload.

upload_urls.title: Upload Urls
upload_urls.description: Presigned upload URLs, one per upload part.

method.title: Method
method.description: HTTP method clients must use for each presigned upload URL.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Additional headers clients should send with the upload request.

file_path.title: File Path
file_path.description: Storage path returned by `/v2/storage/uploads` for the multipart upload.

etags.title: Etags
etags.description: ETags for uploaded parts, ordered by part number. String ETags are accepted for compatibility.

file_path.title: File Path
file_path.description: Storage path for the completed storage upload.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Final URL of the completed uploaded file.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Locale code used in API requests.

dubbing_support.title: Dubbing Support
dubbing_support.description: Whether dubbing workflows support this language.

voice_cloning_support.title: Voice Cloning Support
voice_cloning_support.description: Whether voice cloning is supported for this language.

text_support.title: Text Support
text_support.description: Whether text/document workflows support this language.

target_language.title: Target Language
target_language.description: Target locale code for this translation.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name used for the registered item.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Source URL submitted for this item.

status.title: Status
status.description: Whether this item was registered or failed validation/registration.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: Reusable registered job ID when registration succeeds.

media_type.title: Media Type
media_type.description: Detected or supplied media type for the registered item.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Uploaded or externally hosted file URL to register as media or a document.

name.title: Name
name.description: Optional display name for the registered media/document.

media_type.title: Media Type
media_type.description: Optional media type hint. If omitted, Lingopal infers it from the file.

upload_url.title: Upload Url
upload_url.description: Presigned URL used to upload this part with the documented HTTP method.

part_number.title: Part Number
part_number.description: One-based part number returned by the storage upload response.

etag.title: Etag
etag.description: ETag returned by S3 after uploading this part.
